short_description:
The easiest early helicopter in GTA 6: a private dock in Southwind. Turn off at the Sherwin Boatworks and Chicki's Tiki Bar signs; the dock is east of the parking lot. It isn't a guaranteed spawn, so check back if it's empty. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #19 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PC Gamer, The Click, TheGamer, PowerPyx.

El helicóptero más fácil al principio de GTA 6: un muelle privado en Southwind. Gira en los carteles de Sherwin Boatworks y Chicki's Tiki Bar; el muelle está al este del aparcamiento. No siempre aparece. Fuentes: PC Gamer, The Click, TheGamer, PowerPyx.
